reviews.title: Healing Psoriasis
reviews.text: I struggled with psoriasis for 15 years and have discovered that internal stress reduction is the ultimate fix. And my journey led me to Wim Hof. I have been using this app for two months now everyday at least 3 times a day doing the guided breathing exercises. Within the first two days I noticed improvements in my skin, so I was excited to continue.  30 days in and my skin was the best it had been in years. 60 days in and I am confident to walk around with no shirt on.  Although that might not sound spectacular, but to anyone whose entire torso is covered with plaques, it is a beautiful thing to be free enough to show off your skin. I recommend this app to anyone dealing with autoimmune and stress issues.
